name: Gigantorhiza titanica
story: A rhizomorph former scaled up: black cables five hundred hyphae thick that advance a millimetre an hour and feed mushrooms the size of a table. Invented by Claude on 2026-11-10 for the plugins: not a real species, and any likeness of the name to a real one is accidental. It takes every value it does not set from the RHIZ family.
